items.title: An inline box's width on a line WebKit places in visual order is InlineRect::setRight's float32 result, not the sum of its children; the library's display box and the element rect it gives are a float32 step or two off
items.source: round 4 evaluation, fresh sets eval-r4-1 to -3: 12 cases with the lab's facts and 1 of them (`c-48c81e6d8f5d8d7d`) with none pass lineCount, breaks and widths and hold exactly one differing predicted value, each `element 0 rect k width` one or two float32 steps off (41.159996032714844 natively, 41.15999984741211 expected), on lines under text-align: center, in an RTL block or beside a negative margin; traced at the correctness line, 2026-09-18 (InlineDisplayContentBuilder.cpp:728-822, InlineRect.h:237-244, FloatRect.h:139-143, InlineLineBox.cpp:128-135)
items.note: Not an observation rule: the port already applies FloatQuad::boundingBox to element rects (lab/observe/webkit.ts boxRect), and the differing value is the width of the library's own `inline-box` display box. On a bidi line adjustVisualGeometryForDisplayBox starts from the line box's logical rect of the inline box (logicalBorderBoxForInlineBox, whose width leaves out a hanging trailing space), sets its left to the running edge L and its right to the running edge R after the children, and setRight is FloatRect::shiftMaxXEdgeTo: width = max(0, w0 + (R − (L + w0))), every step in float32. `c-cb91481c4f72e2ef` and `c-e13d8aa9e28342ab` to the bit: w0 33.33092498779297 (the Arabic word without the hanging space), L 94.92437744140625, R 133.87013244628906 give 38.94574737548828, which reports as f32(f32(L + w) − L) = 38.94573974609375, the native width; the library has R − L = 38.94575500488281. The members on lines without bidi content (`c-48c81e6d8f5d8d7d`: 41.15999984741211 expected, 41.159996032714844 native, the text box's own width on a centred line with a hanging space) go through processNonBidiContent and aren't traced to the bit. The fix is in rebuild/src/engines/webkit's display boxes (the inline box width on both paths, with the line box's width as the starting value), several lines with a new engine value, so it stays in the tail; the tier sets hold no such case (0 of 1,334 rich pre-wrap cases at their widths; 0 differing predicted values in webkit-host's frozen ledgers), the fresh sets 12 with the lab's facts and 1 without. It was kind `lab` until this trace.
